core: Plasma membrane lipid and protein organization
qualifier: phospholipid scrambling/flipping and apical CFTR trafficking
name: Plasma membrane phospholipid scrambling and apical protein trafficking
rationale: Members concern plasma membrane composition: aminophospholipid flipping and Ca2+-activated scrambling (ANO6), membrane repair, rafts and blebs, plus polarized Golgi-to-membrane delivery of apical cargo such as CFTR, which separates it from the apoptotic PS-exposure, pancreatic-duct and bile-transporter neighbours.

name: Urea cycle, its inborn errors and arginine-ornithine transport
rationale: All members cover ammonia detoxification through the urea cycle (enzymes, NAGS/CPS1/OTC/ASS1/ASL/ARG1 deficiencies, citrulline/arginine/ornithine metabolism) and cationic amino acid transport (SLC25A15, SLC7A7), distinct from the proline and glutamate/glutamine neighbours.

core: GPCR control of adenylate cyclase and cAMP
name: Gi/Gz-mediated adenylate cyclase inhibition, alpha-2 adrenergic
rationale: Members describe GPCR regulation of adenylate cyclase and cAMP synthesis, centred on inhibitory Gi/Gz coupling via alpha-2 adrenergic receptors, unlike neighbours focused on adrenoceptor secretion control, downstream PKA/PDE, or muscarinic/purinergic receptors.

name: Polyamine metabolism and tryptophan-kynurenine NAD+ biosynthesis
rationale: Members are either polyamine synthesis, interconversion and transport (ODC, putrescine, spermidine, spermine) or tryptophan catabolism via kynurenine to NAD+/nicotinate; neighbours carry only one of these blocks.

name: Mitochondrial gene expression and tRNA maturation
rationale: Most members are mtDNA replication, transcription, RNA processing and mitoribosomal translation, together with tRNA processing, modification and aminoacylation; neighbours focus on cytosolic rRNA modification or translation-factor modification.

qualifier: cardiomyocyte proliferation, growth and ventricular myocardium
name: Cardiomyocyte proliferation, differentiation and ventricular myocardium growth
rationale: Members regulate cardiac muscle cell proliferation, differentiation, hypertrophy, regeneration and compact/trabecular ventricular myocardium, whereas neighbours emphasise septation, endocardium and second heart field.

qualifier: HSF1 heat shock and chaperone refolding
name: HSF1 heat shock response and chaperone-mediated protein refolding
rationale: Members cover HSF1 activation and attenuation, heat acclimation and chaperone-driven refolding (including UPRmt), distinguishing it from chaperonin folding, ER UPR and stress-granule neighbours.

qualifier: control of VEGF, FGF and TGF-beta2 production
name: Sprouting angiogenesis and angiogenic growth factor production
rationale: Members regulate endothelial proliferation, migration and branching in sprouting angiogenesis and the production of VEGF, FGF and TGF-beta2, whereas neighbours carry negative regulation only, Tie2/VEGFR receptor events, or leukocyte adhesion and remodeling.

qualifier: restraint of growth and apoptosis; nephric duct and ureter
name: Restraint of kidney growth and nephric duct-ureter morphogenesis
rationale: Members regulate meso/metanephros development, kidney size and developmental apoptosis/proliferation and form the nephric duct and ureter, unlike neighbours centred on ureteric bud branching or metanephric mesenchyme differentiation.

qualifier: monocyte/DC and CD1 lipid antigen presentation
name: Monocyte and dendritic cell surface signatures, CD1 lipid presentation
rationale: Members are surface-marker signatures of monocytes, dendritic cells and other leukocytes plus CD1/butyrophilin lipid antigen presentation, separating it from MHC class II peptide presentation, T cell costimulation and neutrophil neighbours.

name: Defective proteoglycan linker tetrasaccharide synthesis (linkeropathies)
rationale: All three members are inherited defects of B4GALT7, B3GALT6 and B3GAT3, the enzymes building the shared GAG-protein linker, unlike neighbours on keratan, heparan or chondroitin sulfate chain synthesis.

name: Catecholamine reuptake and monoamine oxidative degradation
rationale: Members cover dopamine/norepinephrine synthesis, SLC6A2/SLC6A3 reuptake and their defects, and MAO/COMT catabolism of monoamines, distinct from serotonin synthesis/uptake and vesicular loading neighbours.

name: Stalled-ribosome quality control and cytoplasmic stress granule dynamics
rationale: Members are ribosome-associated quality control of stalled ribosomes (ZNF598/RQT, RQC) and stress granule assembly/disassembly, unlike neighbours on general proteasomal degradation, ERAD or aggrephagy.

qualifier: heart tube, second heart field and septation
name: Embryonic heart tube, second heart field and septum morphogenesis
rationale: Members describe cardiogenesis from heart tube patterning and second heart field specification to ventricle formation and septum morphogenesis, distinguishing it from conduction-system, valve/cushion, outflow-tract and cardiomyocyte-growth neighbours.

qualifier: common gamma-chain, IL-6 and IL-12/IL-10 families
name: Interleukin JAK-STAT signaling: gamma-chain, IL-6 and IL-12 families
rationale: Members are cytokine-receptor signaling via JAK-STAT for IL-2/7/9/15/21, IL-6/CNTF/LIF, IL-12/23/27/35 and IL-10/20 families, distinct from neighbours on IL-37, type II/III interferon or paracrine signaling.

name: Activin signaling and gonadotropin secretion
rationale: Members are activin pathway regulation (follistatin, TGFBR3) and promotion of FSH and LH secretion, whereas neighbours concern Sertoli/follicle biology or TGFBR3 roles in other ligands.

qualifier: KIT, FLT3, PDGFR, ALK, FGFR and inhibitor resistance
name: Oncogenic KIT/FLT3/PDGFR/ALK/FGFR mutants and kinase-inhibitor resistance
rationale: All members are cancer mutants, fusions or amplifications of KIT, FLT3, PDGFR, ALK/LTK and FGFR and their TKI binding or resistance, separating it from ERBB2/EGFR mutants and normal FLT3/EPO signaling neighbours.

name: VEGF/VEGFR and Tie2 control of sprouting angiogenesis
rationale: Members positively and negatively regulate endothelial sprouting, proliferation and migration through VEGF-VEGFR2/neuropilin and Tie2 signaling, unlike neighbours on endothelial junctions, endothelial differentiation or leukocyte adhesion.

name: ER-Golgi-endosome vesicle trafficking and Rab/ARF GTPase regulation
rationale: Members cover COPII/COPI transport, Golgi organisation, TGN-endosome-lysosome routing, recycling and Rab/ARF GTPase control, distinct from neighbours on ER protein insertion, folding and ERAD.

name: Mucosal antibacterial defense via agglutination and metal sequestration
rationale: Members address host responses to bacteria at mucosae: bacterial attachment and agglutination, metal sequestration, cytolysis and Gram-positive defense, unlike defensin, antifungal and antimicrobial-peptide production neighbours.

qualifier: Dishevelled level, canonical and Wnt/Ca2+ branches
name: Dishevelled-mediated canonical and noncanonical Wnt/Ca2+ signaling
rationale: Members center on DVL activation and degradation, destruction complex disassembly and WNT5A/Ca2+ non-canonical signaling, unlike neighbours on Wnt ligand secretion or FZD ubiquitination/RNF43.

name: MECP2 neuronal transcription and sensory-social behavior
rationale: Members are MECP2 regulation and its Rett-associated loss-of-function events plus behaviors and brain regions it affects (vocalization, touch, prepulse inhibition, social interaction, amygdala/striatum), distinguished from motor/glycinergic neighbours.

name: BH3-only protein activation of BAX/BAK at mitochondria
rationale: Members are activation and mitochondrial translocation of BH3-only proteins (BIM, BAD, BMF, PUMA, NOXA) and BAX/BAK oligomerization leading to cytochrome c release, upstream of the apoptosome and distinct from p53 transcriptional neighbours.

qualifier: phenotypic switching and SRF cytoskeletal targets
name: Vascular smooth muscle phenotypic switching and SRF-driven cytoskeletal program
rationale: Members regulate vascular smooth muscle proliferation, migration, apoptosis, differentiation and phenotypic switching with SRF-target actin modules, unlike cardiac muscle or endothelial shear-stress neighbours.

qualifier: CSF1 receptor and DAP12, proliferation and fusion
name: CSF1 and DAP12 signaling in macrophage proliferation and fusion
rationale: Members are M-CSF/CSF1R and DAP12 tyrosine kinase signaling controlling macrophage proliferation and fusion, unlike neighbours on osteoclast differentiation, SIRP interactions or CSF production.
